annotation.title_clean: Chair's summary – Second 2025 session of the GGE on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.title_en: Chair's summary – Second 2025 session of the GGE on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Chairperson of the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (H.E. Robert in den Bosch, Netherlands)
annotation.summary_en: Chair's summary of the September 2025 CCW Group of Governmental Experts session on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records discussions on the five-box rolling text of elements for a possible instrument: characterization of LAWS, IHL application, prohibitions and regulations, lifecycle obligations, and accountability. It notes remaining divergences, especially on 'context-appropriate human judgement and control'.
key_provisions_or_claims: Rolling text characterizes LAWS as systems that can select and engage targets without human operator intervention
Two-tier approach: prohibitions on LAWS that cannot comply with IHL, plus regulation via context-appropriate human judgement and control
States should conduct legal reviews, testing, bias mitigation and training across the LAWS lifecycle
Accountability cannot be transferred to machines; States must ensure domestic investigation and redress
Divergences remain on 'lethal', 'identify', 'ethical considerations' and human control; Chair plans further consultations before 2026 Review Conference
